metadata.scenario: A prospect requires immediate technical assistance to prevent a major disruption. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you? Hi, my name is David Anderson. I'm calling because my wife just had a stroke and needs urgent physical therapy and nursing care. I'm so sorry to hear about your wife, David. I can assist you with that. Can I get a few details first? Yes, please. We need help right away. She's still in the hospital but will be discharged soon. Understood. Could you provide me with her expected discharge date? The doctor mentioned she might be released in two days. Great, we can arrange for services to start right after her discharge. That would be perfect. What kind of physical therapy do you offer? We offer in-home physical therapy that focuses on post-surgery rehabilitation, mobility training, and stroke recovery. What are the costs for that? It ranges from $110 to $140 per session for about 45 to 60 minutes. Okay, that sounds reasonable. What about nursing care? Our skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125 for a 1 to 2-hour visit. We definitely need both services. Can you arrange that? Yes, I can schedule both physical therapy and skilled nursing care for your wife. That would be great. How soon can someone come? I'll need to check our availability, but we typically can have someone on-site soon after discharge. Please, it’s urgent. She needs support immediately. I understand, David. I will prioritize this. Can I have your wife's full name and any specific care needs? Her name is Sarah Anderson. I’m really worried about her medication management as well. We can provide medication management as part of her nursing care. That’s good to hear. Can you also help with insurance authorization? Yes, our care coordinator can assist with that. Would you like me to connect you with her? Yes, please. I need to sort this out quickly. I’ll have Lisa Chen, our Care Coordinator, give you a call right after this conversation. Thank you. I appreciate your help. You’re welcome! I’ll make sure we expedite your requests. So, can I expect a call from Lisa soon? Yes, she’ll reach out within the next hour. Thank you for your assistance and understanding. It’s my pleasure, David. We’re here to help your family through this. Alright, I’ll wait for Lisa’s call. Sounds good. Have a great day, and take care. You too, bye. Goodbye.
